parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

> - The recommended new calling method is to pass only the image. When only ImageURL is passed, all API data is returned. The new version supports returning data for up to 10 faces.

- For backward compatibility with the legacy API, the logic for Boolean input parameters and MaxFaceNumber is supported. When any supported Boolean input parameter or MaxFaceNumber is passed to control the returned data, only data for Boolean parameters set to true is returned. This calling method does not return data outside the scope of Boolean parameters (Landmarks, LandmarkCount, PoseList, Pupils).

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: For backward compatibility with the legacy API. Specifies whether to return the face mask result. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false.

parameters.name: MaxFaceNumber
parameters.description: For backward compatibility with the legacy API. The maximum number of faces to return in the image. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 1. To return multiple face detection results, set this parameter correctly. Results are sorted in descending order by the FaceProbabilityList response parameter.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: For backward compatibility with the legacy API. Specifies whether to return the face quality score. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false.
